name: soma-user-private-maps-list
description: The member's read of a season's enabled boards. Cached on the `season` namespace like the rest of the season's public reads: an admin enables and disables a board at any time before the close, and maps-add and maps-update bump `season` in the same run, so a reader sees the flip at once. The ladder never reads this route: pair reads the boards from Postgres. Signed in and uncached: it answers a private season to whoever may see it.
